'''The Spin''' was the historical name of portions of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] and [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], used until the [[Kymoodon Era]]. It consisted of the Metellos Trade Route from [[Alland]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and from there the Corellian Run south to [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
